title: [[Wikilinks]] in documents resolve to links — today they render as literal text
desc: Filed 2026-08-12 on the human's word (separate item, not folded into daily-notes): their vault's notes lean on Obsidian-style [[target]] and [[target|label]], which olai's markdown pipeline currently renders as literal bracket text (visible in the human's daily-note screenshot). Scope: resolve wikilinks at render time in the sanitising pipeline (markdown/render.ts + rewrite.ts territory) — [[target|label]] shows label, [[target]] shows target; resolution order: a served document whose basename or path matches → /doc/<path>; a node id match → /n/<id>; unresolved stays visibly distinct (muted, title says unresolved — never silently a dead link, per HACKING error-surfacing). Inline-only contexts (node titles via title.ts) get the same treatment. Tests over the resolution table and the sanitiser (a wikilink must not open an injection seam). Depends on nothing in flight; touches markdown/ only. NOT DISPATCHED.
